# harborpilot_model_alias (Resource)

A model name clients request, resolved to a pool or another alias.

Changes made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and shown as a diff of `spec`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_model_alias" "coding" {
  name = "coding/default"
  spec = jsonencode({
    pool_id               = harborpilot_pool.coding.id
    required_capabilities = ["tools"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name (lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).
- `spec` (String) The model alias specification as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. See the `AliasSpec` schema in the Harbor Pilot API reference. Properties you leave out are sent as their zero value (empty string, list or map, `0`, `false`), except `enabled`, which must be set.

### Read-Only

- `drift_state` (String) `drifted` when the object was changed outside Terraform since Terraform last wrote it.
- `id` (String) Stable object id.
- `managed_by` (String) Source of the last change (`terraform` after an apply).
- `revision` (Number) Server revision, used for optimistic concurrency.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by name.
terraform import harborpilot_model_alias.example <id-or-name>
```
